talks.summary: Overview: Jeff Krakenberg's talk Digital Certificates: Fails and Flounders covers common misconfigurations of digital certificates found in the wild, including exposed mail servers, HTTP redirects, faulty firewalls, and self-signed certificates on public-facing applications. The session explains why certificates matter, common failure patterns, and practical defenses including OCSP, CRLs, and DNS filtering for technical audiences.
